name: qiankun-micro-frontend-monorepo
description: Qiankun微前端架构Monorepo项目 - 包含主应用和多个子应用

scripts.dev:react-apps: concurrently "npm run dev --workspace=apps/react-app-1" "npm run dev --workspace=apps/react-app-2" "npm run dev --workspace=apps/react-app-3" "npm run dev --workspace=apps/react-app-4" "npm run dev --workspace=apps/react-app-5"
scripts.dev:vue-apps: concurrently "npm run dev --workspace=apps/vue-app-1" "npm run dev --workspace=apps/vue-app-2" "npm run dev --workspace=apps/vue-app-3"
scripts.build:all: npm run build:shared && npm run build:main && npm run build:apps
scripts.build:apps: npm run build:react-apps && npm run build:vue-apps
scripts.build:react-apps: npm run build --workspace=apps/react-app-1 && npm run build --workspace=apps/react-app-2 && npm run build --workspace=apps/react-app-3 && npm run build --workspace=apps/react-app-4 && npm run build --workspace=apps/react-app-5
scripts.build:vue-apps: npm run build --workspace=apps/vue-app-1 && npm run build --workspace=apps/vue-app-2 && npm run build --workspace=apps/vue-app-3
scripts.test:all: npm run test:shared && npm run test:main && npm run test:apps
scripts.test:apps: npm run test:react-apps && npm run test:vue-apps
scripts.test:react-apps: npm run test --workspace=apps/react-app-1 && npm run test --workspace=apps/react-app-2 && npm run test --workspace=apps/react-app-3 && npm run test --workspace=apps/react-app-4 && npm run test --workspace=apps/react-app-5
scripts.test:vue-apps: npm run test --workspace=apps/vue-app-1 && npm run test --workspace=apps/vue-app-2 && npm run test --workspace=apps/vue-app-3
scripts.lint:all: npm run lint:shared && npm run lint:main && npm run lint:apps
scripts.lint:apps: npm run lint:react-apps && npm run lint:vue-apps
scripts.lint:react-apps: npm run lint --workspace=apps/react-app-1 && npm run lint --workspace=apps/react-app-2 && npm run lint --workspace=apps/react-app-3 && npm run lint --workspace=apps/react-app-4 && npm run lint --workspace=apps/react-app-5
scripts.lint:vue-apps: npm run lint --workspace=apps/vue-app-1 && npm run lint --workspace=apps/vue-app-2 && npm run lint --workspace=apps/vue-app-3
scripts.clean:all: npm run clean:shared && npm run clean:main && npm run clean:apps
scripts.clean:apps: npm run clean:react-apps && npm run clean:vue-apps
scripts.clean:react-apps: npm run clean --workspace=apps/react-app-1 && npm run clean --workspace=apps/react-app-2 && npm run clean --workspace=apps/react-app-3 && npm run clean --workspace=apps/react-app-4 && npm run clean --workspace=apps/react-app-5
scripts.clean:vue-apps: npm run clean --workspace=apps/vue-app-1 && npm run clean --workspace=apps/vue-app-2 && npm run clean --workspace=apps/vue-app-3
scripts.type-check:all: npm run type-check:shared && npm run type-check:main && npm run type-check:apps
scripts.analyze: npm run analyze:main && npm run analyze:apps
scripts.analyze:apps: npm run analyze:react-apps && npm run analyze:vue-apps
